next.reason: 1985: the values of data-name-1, -3 and -4 'at the time an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase is executed' size the first logical page, and at the time 'a WRITE statement with the ADVANCING PAGE phrase is executed or a page overflow condition occurs' the next. §2023:13.18.34.4 GR6 b) takes the content 'At the completion of an OPEN statement with the OUTPUT phrase', during a WRITE with ADVANCING PAGE and during a WRITE causing page overflow, and 'the value applies to the next logical page'. Same instants and effect. GR2, GR4 and GR5 restate what the values mean (1985 GR2, GR4, GR5), and the EC-I-O-LINAGE check carries the 1985 value limits, not this timing rule.
